name: Zvezda
about: Zvezda (2000-037A), a crewed vehicle (DOS), launched 2000 Jul 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2000 Jul 14), held fixed
docked to S25544; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
